title: wtm comments
description: Line comments of one git worktree, written by worktree-monitor (wtm).

repo.description: Canonical git common directory of the repository the worktree belongs to; files of its removed worktrees are deleted on startup.

side.description: Diff side a line number refers to: deleted lines only exist in the old file.

text.description: The line's text when the comment was written.

id.description: Unique within the worktree (creation time in nanoseconds).

file.description: Repository-relative path of the commented file.

line.description: Line number on `side`; the last line of a range, below which the comment is shown.

line_text.description: Text of `line` when the comment was written; used to follow the line when the file changes.

start.description: First line of a comment on a range of lines.

commit.description: Commit the line was viewed in; null for the working tree.

head.description: Worktree HEAD when the comment was written.

closed.description: Set once the comment is handled (fixed or dropped); absent while it is open.

replies.description: Replies to the comment, oldest first; absent when there are none. Adding, editing or deleting a reply never opens or closes the comment.

id.description: Unique within the comment (creation time in nanoseconds).

by.description: Who wrote it: "user" from the TUI, else the name given to `wtm comments reply --by` (e.g. an agent's).
Who closed it: "user" from the TUI, else the name given to `wtm comments close --by` (e.g. an agent's).
